about: The Zapier builds of chapter 3 (KB-137 section 9, 'Showing Zapier'), as clean data: every step, setting and mapping, with each ID, address and key replaced by a placeholder in capitals. Written from the as-built record (slice/zapier/BUILD.md and docs/v2/chapter-3-notes.md, including the changes made while building), not exported by Zapier. Zapier can email a JSON export of the Zaps (Settings, Security and data, 'Download my Zap workflows'); when that file is in hand, scripts/clean_exports.py zapier cleans it, and tests/test_clean_exports.py checks this record against it. All three Zaps are off; the MCP client is disconnected.
